svg.title: SenseSearch, HR-MMsearch Benchmark, and Overall Performance
svg.desc: Complete editable SVG reconstruction. Base frames: f01 left SenseSearch workflow with question, reasoning/tool/search steps, icons and mini image constructions; f02 upper-right HR-MMsearch benchmark with feature bullets and pie chart; f03 lower-right overall performance bar chart. No SAM assets were provided, so all content is constructed natively with SVG.

g.desc: Inventory: a stacked SenseSearch reasoning trace. Left margin alternates user/robot and gear icons. The workflow starts with a natural language question and a racing thumbnail, then proceeds downward through think boxes, dashed tool boxes for image crop, text search, image search, and final answer. Mini crops, scissors, result snippets, colored emphasized words, arrows and the lower panel label are included.

text.tspan: How many years separate the founding year of the company
indicated by the black logo on the lower left of the racer's
suit and the racer's birth year?
First, I need to identify the company name indicated that I must
see the logo clearly. I will utilize the image crop tool.
now I can see clearly that the company is

g.text: Castore was founded by Tomas and Philip

text.tspan: use image search to identify this racer.
I found the company was founded in 2015 and the driver was born in 1997.

g.desc: Inventory: upper right benchmark panel. Left side lists three highlighted features with yellow circular arrow bullets. Right side is a pastel pie chart with eight domains, percent labels, category labels and small icons. Panel caption b) HR-MMsearch Benchmark sits underneath the pie.

Inventory: lower right panel contains grouped bar chart for FVQA, MMSearch and HR-MMSearch. It includes y-axis accuracy, gridlines, four-model legend, numerical value labels on bars, category labels and caption c) Overall Performance.
